description: Check a 1-4 unit investment property deal (business-purpose, borrower is an LLC or corporation) against the published limits of 13 investor lenders (Kiavi, Lima One, RCN Capital, Visio, LendingOne, Easy Street, CoreVest, New Silver, Angel Oak, Griffin Funding, Dominion Financial, Temple View, Asset Based Lending) and the Doors Funded programs. Returns each lender grouped by fit, with the limit that fails or the term to ask about, plus a link that sends the deal to Doors Funded.

dscr.description: Debt service coverage ratio, e.g. 1.15 (use dscr_check to work it out)

flips.description: Flips completed in the last 3 years

foreign_national.description: Borrower has no US citizenship or green card

prod.description: Loan type: DSCR rental, fix and flip, ground-up construction, or rental portfolio (blanket)

state.description: Two-letter US state code of the property, e.g. "TX" (50 states and DC)

units.description: Units, 1 to 4 (5+ unit property is not covered here)

name: match_deal
title: Match a deal to investor lenders
